card.name: Body temperature and fever readings
card.fires_on: The word after body/oral (temperature) or the digit 0 in a fever value like 100.4°F, plus blood pressure and vaccination words. It appears in dose-adjustment and warning sections.

modes.label: Fever thresholds
modes.description: The 0 inside a fever value such as 100.4°F in toxicity grading tables.

modes.label: Temperature after body or oral
modes.description: The word temperature after a qualifier in fever or neutropenia criteria.

modes.label: Pressure and vaccines
modes.description: The noun after blood, or vaccination terms, in pre-treatment instructions.
modes.example: Optimize blood<< pressure>> prior to starting Kyprolis.

card.plain: It marks vital-sign and fever wording, like temperature and blood pressure, in dose-adjustment instructions.
